title: Too Many Tasks
description: Simple todo list GUI for any world you may create. Too much to do, lets organize those thoughts.
body:
A TODO list controlled by the player. Start by pressing 'R'.
This mod is to help those big pack players organize their thoughts in one simple UI.

Press 'R' will open up a task list menu
You can hit the 'X' on the side of the task to remove it or select complete task
  to cross it out
You can add more items at the top input text field and click 'add'
